title: Meaning of building envelope for attic and roof spaces (definition question)
jurisdiction: Alberta (province-wide STANDATA issued by Alberta Municipal Affairs)
code_edition: NBC(AE) 2023 (National Building Code - 2023 Alberta Edition); printing not stated in document
document_date: Date Issued: January 2026 (platform created January 20, 2026, last updated January 20, 2026)

facts.text: The interpretation clarifies the intended meaning of building envelope in NBC(AE) as it relates to the expected performance of attic or roof spaces.
The NECB 2020 definition of building envelope has been applied by some to NBC(AE); Sentence 1.4.1.1.(1) of Division A allows such terms, but the interpretation sets the NBC(AE) meaning.
The roof and exterior wall assemblies of an attic or roof space may not be thermally insulated; they still serve the envelope purpose of keeping out precipitation.
The interpretation's meaning for attic and roof spaces is set out in its Interpretation section.
